credential_pattern_scan.limitation: Recognizable-pattern scan of inspected bytes and recoverable decoded contents, not a proof that every possible secret encoding is absent. Known malformed fixtures and the disclosed historical partial raw remain unchanged.
credential_pattern_scan.privacy: Only path, type and count are recorded for any credential match; no matching values or excerpts are emitted.

delta_method.description: v1 recorded the aggregate candidate inventory hash but not its per-file list. To avoid assuming unchanged bytes, files bound by identical fullgate-v1 before/after captures encompassing the v1 audit, or explicit v1 source/gold pins, are exempted from repeat credential scanning. Every other current candidate is conservatively scanned, including all new or changed files. This is a conservative superset, not a claimed exact historical path diff.

finalizer_review.scope: Read-only review of finalizer plus direct verification of the recorded archive; no new adversarial-test suite or re-execution of finalizer.
